protagonist_backgrounds.name: Disgraced Clerk
protagonist_backgrounds.description: You kept the Ledger until three pages went missing on your watch

protagonist_backgrounds.name: Quay Dockhand
protagonist_backgrounds.description: You hauled chain for Brannock until you saw what came off the barges

major_npcs.name: The Assessor
major_npcs.role: Crown auditor sent to close the Customs House
major_npcs.goal: Find someone to hang for the forgery before the flood
interaction_hooks: Offers your seal back for a name

companions.name: Ysolde
companions.role: Apostate tide-priest who kept her salt-scale
companions.goal: Prove Mother Esk forged the Ledger without drowning anyone else
interaction_hooks: Will weigh anything you bring her
Refuses to enter the tithe altar
relationship_rules: Trust rises when you refuse priestly bribes
Trust falls if you sell pages
availability_rules: Joins after you weigh the missing scale weight with her
